text:
The recoverability program models a system under defect accumulation, repair pressure, and ordered updates. The central variables in the V824 accessibility paper are defect burden μ, repair field, recoverability surplus C, and reachable-state accessibility density A. The update parameter τ is ordered recoverability updates — not necessarily physical time.

The 17 May recoverability framework freeze lives on /wiki/recoverability-framework. This page keeps the operator, the May conformal week, mouse, and the July gates. Current science is /wiki/live-gates. Do not treat this article as a second spine.

A = \exp(C - \mu + \eta\,\mathrm{repair})

Interpretation: recoverability pressure creates a density of reachable states. Where that density is spatially compressed, a curvature-like scalar response appears. That is a geometry-like operator on an information field, not a derivation of Einstein’s equation.

Why “before time”

Spradlin’s gravity posts insist that recoverability deformation and support-loss pruning are defined on a timeless information layer. Time, entropy, and classical geometry are later projections. The methodological bet is that if gravity is quantized as just another force, the category error is already made: gravity is the cost of making informational sources jointly recoverable.

Gravity is not a fundamental interaction waiting to be quantized. It is an emergent phenomenon that appears when informational sources deform the recoverability structure of a timeless information layer — before time, entropy, or classical geometry exist.

Governor-enforced recoverability flow

On 15 May 2026 a V831 run was posted as a recoverability-flow simulation: a software governor enforcing conservation-like repair, reserve, and defect-accounting constraints on another symbolic system, until conformal geometry-like flow appears from information dynamics alone. A 20 May restatement froze the same instrument as a full-stack branch (conformal Ω, curvature concentrations; posted ADM-like currents). A follow-up quoted GeminiPro: it is software forcing other software to obey physical-like laws that do not exist in the computer until the governor writes them. Same instrument family as C3++. Not GR. The same-day V824 lock pruned tensor/ADM momentum — this wiki keeps that prune.

On the posted V831 run, a governor can force repair/reserve/defect constraints and the observed flow is geometry-like. That is an applied recoverability instrument. It is not a derivation of Einstein dynamics.

May 2026: heat-kernel week, then a theorem-shaped flow

17 May restated the invariant as persistence of perturbation → response → restored future trajectory space (Lyapunov of V[Ω,C,μ] named, not closed). 19 May V760 froze the atrium metric in a sim. None of that is GR. The Recoverability framework article holds the freeze; the month page holds the equations, git links, and films.

V498/V541/V555: theorem-shaped conformal recoverability flow with a synthetic adversarial harness (AUC 1.0 / 1.0). Not a completed theorem and not Einstein dynamics.

Mouse: recoverability lost one way

The 16 Jun mouse toy makes the same recoverability point as a pruning network. Time in the sim is irreversible deletion of the weight matrix; once a connection is gone, pathfinding can return empty while the destination still exists in the array. Restricted illustration. Full six-isomorphism list and films live on Genesis Pin and Proofs. Not GR.

In the posted mouse, recoverability is lost one way under pruning. Exact in that code. Not a cosmological arrow-of-time derivation.

Admissible body, not a unique history

On 20 Jul 2026 the next structural question was written down in public: the admissible body A_G names which collections are allowed, but membership is not a ranking. Provenance only forces a support-poset — one collection can be strictly more pruned than another. A law that would pick a unique path through A_G is still open. Calendar for that week: July 2026 ladder.

Provenance gives a canonical support-poset, but a unique pruning sequence is still open.

Whether provenance constraints induce a monotone chain of minimal faces, or several inequivalent support-loss orders remain compatible with the same A_G data.

Reciprocity is not focusing

On 23 Jul 2026 an 11-part original asked whether globally compatible quantum information already forces one shared source generator before geometry exists. On 25 Jul a 20-part report answered the narrower question that is actually closed. Both threads lived only on X — no Tmp/TOE folder — so the GitHub-first compile never opened them.

C_{ji}=C_{ij}^{\sharp}\qquad\text{but}\qquad \text{reciprocity}\not\Rightarrow\text{focusing sign}

Derived: A_G is compact and convex; a bipartite state does not canonically determine a Hilbert-fiber map; each edge defines an intrinsic BKM response with exact adjoint reciprocity; a common aggregate mode is not universal edgewise coupling. Reciprocity does not imply attraction. A sufficient focusing law is cone positivity / MTP₂ on increasing observables.

\mathcal A_G^+\subsetneq \mathcal A_G\cap\prod_{e\in E}\mathrm{MTP}_2^{(e)}

Trees: local focusing glues globally. Cycles: global focusing frustration can occur.

The triangle counterexample is an exact finite calculation: pair-marginals that are each strictly associated, yet no globally MTP₂ completion exists. A noisy square at ε=10⁻³ has numerical evidence of the same obstruction (best conditional minor ≈ −5.74×10⁻⁷) — not yet an SOS certificate.

Exact triangle MTP₂ focusing-frustration, and tree local-to-global MTP₂ closure, inside a finite classical commuting sector. Physical gravity not claimed. Square infeasibility remains numerical.

The source-generator gate

Two days earlier the same program narrowed the gravity question to one mathematical gate. Edge response operators K_{i|j} generally pick different leading source lines. A common generator K_{i|j}=f_{ij}(Q_i) would align them. Admissibility plus reciprocity do not produce that generator.

K_{i|j}=f_{ij}(Q_i)\qquad\text{does global quantum provenance canonically generate }Q_i?

The frontier has narrowed from “Can gravity emerge?” to one exact mathematical gate: does global quantum provenance canonically generate Q_i?

Global provenance therefore does not canonically force a shared generator Q_i; an extra protecting law or symmetry appears required to close that gate.

Whether Genesis / provenance can force a shared source generator Q_i. In-thread review: not from admissibility + BKM reciprocity alone. Gravity still not claimed.

UCRP / ECSM linkage — posed, not derived

On 17 Aug 2026 a reply proposed that retained-recombination could sit under someone else’s UCRP/ECSM closures: L3/L4 surplus as a history-dependent origin for the scalar burden generator B, directed holonomy as a structural analogue of the ECSM rotational sector, and admissibility plus focusing frustration as the coherent-limit falsifiers that paper already flags. That is a mapping question. It is not a derivation of UCRP, of ECSM, or of gravity.

Whether recombination cost → B and directed holonomy → rotational sector moves UCRP’s “foundational, not micro-derived” gap. Posted as a substrate candidate. Not a UCRP theorem and not a gravity claim.

The recoverability layer is a modeling primitive of the program. It is not an experimental detection of a pre-geometric physical substance.
